Sorry for the delayed response. I spent about 7 hours on the first day, and another 3 hours finishing the residual cleanup and page optimization work.

**2) WP Engine Support:** They have responded and confirmed that any remaining traces have been cleaned up, so we can be confident the issue is now behind us.
**3) Plugins:** All plugins are now up to date, and any plugins considered high risk have been removed or disabled.
**4) Post Tags:** I found some additional post tags left behind from the earlier spam and have cleared those as well.
5) **Autoptimize plugin** - For future reference, this was added for page speed related adjustments.

**Side notes:**
Do remove me from the site's access once you're satisfied. WordPress, WP Engine, Search Console.
